## You will be able to

- Prioritise AI use cases on value, feasibility and risk
- Read an AI proposal critically and spot red flags
- Own an AI initiative from idea to production with the right gates
- Estimate and control cost; define ROI

## Demos

| # | Demo | Module | Min | Shows |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `01_value_patterns.py` | 2 | 12 | a function's weekly tasks mapped to assist / automate / augment / new product / risk reduction, with hours and rupee value |
| 2 | `02_prioritise_backlog.py` | 3 | 15 | five use cases scored value × feasibility × fit with risk and effort, ranked into quick wins and strategic bets, with budgets — by the engine consultants use |
| 3 | `03_readiness_snapshot.py` | 4 | 12 | the 25-question Free readiness audit scored by the real engine: overall score, maturity level, weakest domains, red flags and 30-day actions |
| 4 | `04_build_buy_partner.py` | 5 | 10 | total cost of ownership for build vs buy over three years, the break-even user count and a lock-in check |
| 5 | `05_red_flag_proposal.py` | 7 | 12 | a vendor proposal scanned for the eight things a serious AI proposal must contain, with the question to ask for each gap |
| 6 | `06_cost_and_roi.py` | 8 | 12 | one feature costed per request and per month in three designs, then a three-year ROI with payback and a what-if |
| 7 | `07_pilot_gates_90_day.py` | 6+10 | 12 | a pilot charter checked against gate criteria, and a one-page 90-day plan generated from five answers |

## Run of show
**One week before:** `python demos/run_all.py` on the laptop you will present from — it must print `ALL DEMOS OK`. Swap `demos/data/` for the client's own examples where you can. Print `exercises.md` per table and the handout per person.
**In the room:** each demo is one command from this folder: `python demos/NN_name.py`. No internet or API key needed. Each ends with a *Say it* line — your closing sentence.
**Live mode:** set `LLM_PROVIDER` and a key in the repo `.env`; demos that benefit then call a real model.
**In the browser:** every demo also runs from the `/demos` page (section *Course labs*) — useful for sales calls and the website.
